from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c16c9305.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [color for color, _ in counts.most_common() if color != background]
    source = colors[0]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == background and row[c - 1] == source and row[c + 1] == source:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
